body:
rachel: Quick follow-up from the storage-surge postmortem. Need runbook edits: triage checklist, pager targets, recurring-patterns section. Who owns what?

diego: I can own triage checklist. Will add exact PromQL and kubectl snippets.

mei: I'll take paging/escalation and confirm backup contacts.

rachel: Also want a canonical first-responder command block so checks are consistent.

diego: Draft commands (will add to runbook):

```
# pod + recent evictions
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=10m | egrep "evict|kv_warm"

# promql
sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])
```

mei: Add these alert names: AlertCacheEvictionHigh, AlertKVWarmSlow. I'll map owners and set escalation levels L1/L2/L3.

rachel: Proposed thresholds: eviction_rate > 2/min for 3m, kv_warmup_duration_seconds > 12s for 5m. I'll review for noise.

diego: I'll open PR for triage checklist by 2026-04-02 with the commands and a short verification checklist.

mei: Escalation matrix + contact updates by 2026-04-04. I'll update on-call rota entries.

rachel: Add a small routing play: if evictions spike and cache hit < 70% route to smaller-context model for 10m. Who owns the play?

diego: I can add the routing play to the PR, include rollback steps and smoke check. Target 2026-04-05.

oncall-bot: Linked postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/storage-surge-19611>. Actions logged to INC-3247. Reminder set for 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC to review PRs.

mei: Summary of owners/due dates:
- diego: triage checklist + commands -> 2026-04-02
- mei: escalation matrix + alert owners -> 2026-04-04
- diego: routing play + rollback -> 2026-04-05
- rachel: review thresholds -> 2026-04-06

rachel: Thanks. Please reference INC-3247 in PRs and add runbook file path. This thread is the canonical action list.
